name: job-seeker-copilot-e2e
description: Playwright, Cucumber and TypeScript E2E tests for Job Seeker Copilot.

scripts.test:local: E2E_PROFILE=demo HEADLESS=false SLOW_MO=100 RECORD_VIDEO=true cucumber-js --profile demo
scripts.test:smoke:ci: E2E_PROFILE=smoke DEMO_MODE=false USE_SAVED_SESSION=false SAVE_DEMO_SESSION=false HEADLESS=true RECORD_VIDEO=false cucumber-js --profile smoke
scripts.test:e2e: E2E_PROFILE=e2e DEMO_MODE=false USE_SAVED_SESSION=false SAVE_DEMO_SESSION=false HEADLESS=true RECORD_VIDEO=false cucumber-js --profile e2e
scripts.test:security: E2E_PROFILE=security DEMO_MODE=false USE_SAVED_SESSION=false SAVE_DEMO_SESSION=false HEADLESS=true RECORD_VIDEO=false cucumber-js --profile security
scripts.test:provider-failure: E2E_PROFILE=provider-failure DEMO_MODE=false USE_SAVED_SESSION=false SAVE_DEMO_SESSION=false HEADLESS=true RECORD_VIDEO=false cucumber-js --profile providerFailure
scripts.test:accessibility: E2E_PROFILE=accessibility DEMO_MODE=false USE_SAVED_SESSION=false SAVE_DEMO_SESSION=false HEADLESS=true RECORD_VIDEO=false cucumber-js --profile accessibility
scripts.test:definitions: E2E_PROFILE=demo cucumber-js --profile demo --dry-run && E2E_PROFILE=smoke DEMO_MODE=false USE_SAVED_SESSION=false SAVE_DEMO_SESSION=false cucumber-js --profile smoke --dry-run && E2E_PROFILE=e2e DEMO_MODE=false USE_SAVED_SESSION=false SAVE_DEMO_SESSION=false cucumber-js --profile e2e --dry-run && E2E_PROFILE=security DEMO_MODE=false USE_SAVED_SESSION=false SAVE_DEMO_SESSION=false cucumber-js --profile security --dry-run && E2E_PROFILE=provider-failure DEMO_MODE=false USE_SAVED_SESSION=false SAVE_DEMO_SESSION=false cucumber-js --profile providerFailure --dry-run && E2E_PROFILE=accessibility DEMO_MODE=false USE_SAVED_SESSION=false SAVE_DEMO_SESSION=false cucumber-js --profile accessibility --dry-run
scripts.verify: npm run verify:tracked-files && npm run verify:profiles && npm run typecheck && npm run test:definitions && npm run test:smoke:ci && npm run test:support
